content:
marco: quick sync — proposal to freeze the SDK-visible routing surface: a tiny, stable set of headers SDKs send (x-rw-route, x-rw-attr, x-rw-route-ver). Move all rich policy/context into an internal-only header added by our mesh. goal: fewer SDK churns + stable console attribution. thoughts?

anya: 👍 on the idea. Main concern: quota & billing currently parse the big route blob. We need a clear fallback so quotas don't miss cost_center.

devin: agree. Suggestion: require x-rw-attr to include cost_center & tenant for public requests. Quota reader should prefer x-rw-attr.cost_center then fallback to parsing route blob for a transition window.

marco: exactly. Also plan a negotiation header x-rw-route-ver to allow middleware to opt into enhanced parsing. SDKs default to ver=1.

infra-bot: noticed past canary failure: edge-proxy-2 logged `header_parse: unexpected EOF` when parsing long route blobs. Proxies truncate headers >1024 bytes.

anya: that's the truncation issue. Two options: (A) forbid SDKs from emitting long internal blobs; (B) require base64-encoded internal blob; (C) split into chunked headers. Base64 hurts console ingestion slowness. I'd prefer forbidding.

sylvie: forbid + platform enrich later is safest. We'll attach internal policy at ingress on the internal mesh, not from clients. For Dedicated customers who run in private networks, we can provide an opt-in env var in SDKs.

devin: SDK compatibility plan: keep parsing both old big header and new compact headers for two releases. Add env RW_ALLOW_INTERNAL_BLOB for Dedicated customers that allows the blob. Default off. Also add unit tests and sample code.

marco: sample header we'll document: 
```
x-rw-route: tenant=acme,env=prod
x-rw-route-ver: 1
x-rw-attr: cost_center=42,team=search
# x-rw-internal: {"policy":"prefer-cheap","trace":"abc"}  # platform-only/internal
```

anya: action items: @devin update quota reader to prefer x-rw-attr, @sylvie confirm platform will enrich internal header on mesh, @marco write RFC and deprecation timeline, @infra-bot file ticket to review proxy header limits.

devin: I'll add fallback parsing and a small monitoring alert: if >1% of requests miss cost_center after rollout, roll back.

infra-bot: opened ticket INF-712 to examine header limits and proxy truncation rules.

sylvie: timeline suggestion: RFC this week, 2-week opt-in canary, 12-week public deprecation for client-emitted internal blobs. SDKs get two releases of compat.

marco: sounds good. I'll draft the RFC and put a changelog snippet for python/ts/go: minor bump, parsing compatibility, env var opt-in, sample code.

anya: also add a console migration plan to use x-rw-attr fields for dashboards and schedule a data-quality check post-canary.

devin: will add unit/integration tests + changelog examples.

marco: cool — RFC link will follow. Thanks everyone.
